descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S04 「现成 spec：Settings 没有口述引擎选择」 Existing spec: Settings offers no dictation engine choice

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 No API key fields, model pickers or dictation engine choice appear anywhere in the app, in Hospital and Nursing Home. This is the OAT-05 part of the AC; bulk delete and demo data are TC-24 scope.（TFA-94700 AC 5）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's chromium fixtures (signed-in account)

When Open /settings and wait for the Settings heading

Then Once the Settings heading is visible, there is no On-device or Cloud engine choice and no 'Choose whether dictation runs' text.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in forms.spec.ts, after the heading wait. This covers the engine-choice part of TFA-94700 AC 5 in Hospital mode. The sibling test 'does not expose model or AI connection controls' is not counted: it asserts toHaveCount(0) right after page.goto('/settings') with no wait for the Settings heading, so it can pass before the modal renders, and it checks only t …
